description: A tutorial/documentation file explaining how to use SQLModel with FastAPI to interact with SQL databases, including creating models, session management, CRUD operations, and best practices for data handling and security.

classes.name: Hero
classes.description: Table model representing the 'hero' entity in the database, includes fields for id, name, age, secret_name.

classes.name: HeroBase
classes.description: Base Pydantic model with shared fields 'name' and 'age' for Hero models.

classes.name: HeroPublic
classes.description: Response model for public hero data, includes id, name, and age, excludes secret_name.

classes.name: HeroCreate
classes.description: Model used for creating new heroes, requires name, age, and secret_name.

classes.name: HeroUpdate
classes.description: Model for updating hero data, all fields optional (name, age, secret_name).

methods.name: create_db_and_tables()
methods.description: Creates all tables in the database when the FastAPI app starts.

methods.name: get_session()
methods.description: Dependency function to provide a SQLModel session per request.
